documents.title: Coway Airmega 150 Specifications & Pricing
documents.content:
Model: Coway Airmega 150 (AP-1019C).
Target Space: Compact bedrooms, study rooms, personal offices.
Room Coverage: Up to 355 sq. ft. (33 sq. meters) with 303 m3/hr CADR.
Pricing: MRP INR 16,999 (Standard Selling Price: INR 14,999).
Filtration System: 3-Stage Filtration featuring Washable Pre-Filter (cartridge-type for easy removal and cleaning), Patented Urethane Carbon Deodorization Filter, and Anti-Virus Green True HEPA Filter trapping 99.97% of airborne allergens and PM0.1 particles.
Key Features: Real-time AQI 4-color LED indicator ring (Blue: Good, Green: Normal, Yellow: Unhealthy, Red: Very Unhealthy), Filter replacement LED reminder, Ultra-quiet operation (22 dB in sleep mode), Power consumption 35 Watts.
Available Colors: White, Moss Green, and Peony Pink.

documents.title: Coway Airmega 250 Specifications & Pricing
documents.content:
Model: Coway Airmega 250 (AP-1720H).
Target Space: Medium to large living rooms, master bedrooms, office lounges.
Room Coverage: Up to 600 sq. ft. (55 sq. meters) with 460 m3/hr CADR.
Pricing: MRP INR 34,999 (Standard Selling Price: INR 29,999).
Filtration System: Multi-directional 360-degree suction with Max2 all-in-one Filter combining Green True HEPA and Activated Carbon.
Key Features: Smart ECO Mode (automatically stops fan when air remains clean for 10 minutes to save power, resumes when pollution detected), Rapid Mode for high-speed cleaning, Real-time PM2.5 numerical/color indicator, Sleep mode (22 dB), Child lock, Power consumption 45 Watts.
Design: Sleek matte finish with bottom pre-filter slide-out tray for convenient cleaning without opening the entire front chassis.

documents.title: Coway Airmega 300 / 300S Specifications & Pricing
documents.content:
Model: Coway Airmega 300 / 300S.
Target Space: Large open-plan apartments, villas, commercial offices.
Room Coverage: Up to 1,256 sq. ft. (117 sq. meters).
Pricing: MRP INR 44,999.
Filtration System: Dual Suction Max2 Filters on both sides of unit for rapid air turnover.
Key Features: Smart Wi-Fi connectivity (300S model) via Coway IoCare Mobile App, Alexa / Google Assistant voice control, Smart Auto mode.

documents.title: Coway Warranty, Filter Life & Customer Support Details
documents.content:
Warranty & Service Coverage:
1. Standard Warranty: 1-Year Comprehensive Warranty covering all electrical components and manufacturing defects.
2. Motor Warranty: 5-Year Extended Warranty on the internal suction motor.
3. Filter Lifespan: Green True HEPA and Max2 filters have an 8,500-hour (approx 1 year of daily use) lifespan. The washable pre-filter should be washed under running water every 2 to 4 weeks.
4. Customer Care Contact: Toll-free Helpline: 1800-102-6960 (Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM IST) or email info@cowayindia.in.
5. Service Turnaround: Pan-India home technician visits within 24 to 48 hours in major metropolitan cities.

documents.title: Troubleshooting: Unit Won't Turn On or Silent Fan
documents.content:
Troubleshooting Steps for Power / Fan Not Starting:
1. Check Power Source: Ensure the power cord is securely plugged into a live 220-240V AC wall outlet and the power button is pressed.
2. Inspect Front Cover Safety Interlock: All Coway Airmega models feature a physical safety interlock switch. If the front panel cover is not snapped tightly into place, the safety switch will disconnect power to the fan to prevent injury.
3. Cover Reseat Procedure: Remove the front cover, verify the pre-filter is properly locked in its upper clips, and then align the bottom tabs of the front cover and push firmly on the top two corners until a solid 'click' sound is heard on both sides.
4. If power indicator light is on but fan does not spin after securing cover, guide the customer to request a technician service visit via 1800-102-6960.

documents.title: Troubleshooting: AQI Light Red / Odor / Noise Issues
documents.content:
Troubleshooting Steps for AQI Sensor and Odor:
1. Red AQI Light Staying On Constantly: The optical particle sensor on the side may have dust accumulation. Open the sensor cover on the right side of the unit and gently wipe the lens with a damp cotton swab, followed by a dry cotton swab. Adjust sensor sensitivity if necessary.
2. Plastic / Unpleasant Smell from New Unit: Check if the plastic wrapping on the internal HEPA/Carbon filters was removed prior to first use. Always unwrap filter plastic before turning on.
3. Sour or Musty Smell: Indicates pre-filter is dirty or carbon filter has reached saturation (> 1 year). Wash pre-filter and replace carbon filter cartridge.
